title: tabline crash on resize

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
<!-- Before reporting: search existing issues and check the FAQ. -->

- `nvim --version`: NVIM v0.5.0-593-g1ca67a73c
- `vim -u DEFAULTS` (version: ) behaves differently? Yes
- Operating system/version: Debian Testing
- Terminal name/version: alacritty 0.4.3
- `$TERM`: alacritty

### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`
  1. 
```bash
nvim -u NORC
```
  2.
```vim
:source vimrc
:tabe vimrc
```
  3. Then resize your window.

Where **vimrc** is:
```vim
call plug#begin('~/.vim/plugins')
Plug 'itchyny/lightline.vim'
call plug#end()

let g:lightline = {
  \ 'tab' : {
  \   'active': [ 'mytabname' ],
  \   'inactive': [ 'mytabname' ]
  \ },
  \ 'tab_component_function' : {
  \   'mytabname': 'MyTabname'
  \ },
  \ 'separator': { 'left': '', 'right': '' },
  \ 'subseparator': { 'left': '', 'right': '' },
  \ }

function! MyTabname(n)
  return ""
endfunction
```

### Actual behaviour

Crashes with the following error: ```double free or corruption (!prev)```

Here is **gdb** acktrace:
```sh
(gdb) bt
#0  __GI_raise (sig=sig@entry=6) at ../sysdeps/unix/sysv/linux/raise.c:50

#2  0x00007ffff7ce3038 in __libc_message (action=action@entry=do_abort, fmt=fmt@entry=0x7ffff7deff3e "%s\n") at ../sysdeps/posix/libc_fatal.c:181
#3  0x00007ffff7cea3da in malloc_printerr (str=str@entry=0x7ffff7df1c50 "double free or corruption (!prev)") at malloc.c:5339
#4  0x00007ffff7cec25c in _int_free (av=0x7ffff7e21b80 <main_arena>, p=0x555555aebd00, have_lock=<optimized out>) at malloc.c:4317
#5  0x0000555555766b9c in xfree (ptr=0x555555aebd10) at ../src/nvim/memory.c:119
#6  0x000055555580a6f2 in screenalloc () at ../src/nvim/screen.c:6257
#7  0x000055555580ad58 in screenclear () at ../src/nvim/screen.c:6375
#8  0x000055555580d898 in screen_resize (width=79, height=31) at ../src/nvim/screen.c:7400
#9  0x000055555588625e in ui_refresh () at ../src/nvim/ui.c:213
#10 0x0000555555886421 in ui_refresh_event (argv=0x7fffffffd208) at ../src/nvim/ui.c:255
#11 0x00005555556ab43d in multiqueue_process_events (this=0x555555ace3b0) at ../src/nvim/event/multiqueue.c:157
#12 0x000055555579370c in nv_event (cap=0x7fffffffd398) at ../src/nvim/normal.c:8069
#13 0x0000555555783cde in normal_execute (state=0x7fffffffd310, key=-26365) at ../src/nvim/normal.c:1138
#14 0x0000555555856612 in state_enter (s=0x7fffffffd310) at ../src/nvim/state.c:69
#15 0x0000555555781f82 in normal_enter (cmdwin=false, noexmode=false) at ../src/nvim/normal.c:463
#16 0x000055555573e42c in main (argc=6, argv=0x7fffffffd698) at ../src/nvim/main.c:552
```

### Expected behaviour

No crash, like **vim**.
Note that this bug only happens when using **empty tab names** and **exotic separators**.
